### ZIM Launches ZX3 – A New Premium Express Service Connecting Shanghai and Xiamen to Los Angeles


October 30, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/172866090/files/doc_news/ZIM-Launches-ZX3--A-New-Premium-Express-Service--Connecting-Shanghai-and-Xiamen-to-Los-Angeles-2026.pdf)


**ZX3 Joins ZIM’s Premium Expedited Network, Now Offering Seven Weekly Departures from China and Vietnam to the US West Coast**


**HAIFA, Israel, October 30, 2026 -** ZIM Integrated Shipping Services (NYSE: ZIM) announced today the launch of **ZX3** , a new premium expedited service **connecting** **Shanghai and Xiamen directly with Los Angeles** , further expanding ZIM's expedited offering across the Transpacific trade.


**Operated exclusively by ZIM** , the new service is scheduled to commence in December 2026 with the following rotation:


**Xiamen - Shanghai - Los Angeles - Xiamen**


**ZX3** will provide a **direct 12-day transit from Shanghai to Los Angeles** and a **best-in-market 15-day transit from Xiamen to Los Angeles** . The service brings an enhanced product to the Shanghai market and a dedicated premium expedited offering to the Xiamen market, while building on ZIM’s commitment to consistent weekly schedule reliability and solutions tailored to enhance supply chain resilience.


Joining ZIM’s established premium expedited service network (ZEX and ZX2), **ZX3** will contribute to a **combined** **frequency of seven weekly departures from China and Vietnam** , giving customers greater flexibility, expanded market coverage, and reliable access to the US West Coast.


**Key advantages include:**


- **Direct calls with berth on arrival in Shanghai and Xiamen** , expanding ZIM's premium network coverage across key markets in China.
- **Dedicated berth upon arrival at the WBCT terminal in Los Angeles, with dedicated ZIM yard and pick up** lanes, supporting efficient and expedited cargo handling at destination.
- **Monday Los Angeles arrival with Expedited cargo availability** , with cargo discharged onto ZIM-dedicated chassis with immediate availability – no appointment or queue required.
- **Expedited rail connections to major US inland destinations** , including New York, Chicago, Memphis, Dallas, Kansas City, and more.


**Hani Kalinski, EVP Pacific Business Unit** said: “The launch of **ZX3** marks an important step in our continued commitment to delivering premium, customer-focused solutions that respond to evolving supply chain needs. By adding Xiamen and an additional direct call in Shanghai to our expedited network, we are providing customers with broader market coverage and greater flexibility. Building on the success of our industry-leading expedited network, **ZX3** further strengthens our differentiated service portfolio and our ability to deliver high-quality, end-to-end customer experience that supports our customers’ growth and supply chain performance”


**About ZIM**


Founded in Israel in 1945, ZIM (NYSE: ZIM) is a leading global container liner shipping company with operations in more than 90 countries, serving over 30,000 customers across more than 300 ports worldwide. ZIM leverages digital strategies and a commitment to ESG values to provide customers innovative seaborne transportation and logistics services and exceptional customer experience. ZIM's differentiated global-niche strategy, based on agile fleet management and deployment, covers major trade routes with a focus on select markets where the company holds competitive advantages. Additional information about ZIM is available at www.ZIM.com.
